items.title: Sumner Labat Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: I used to get Kid Rainey, Kid Howard, Kid Ricardo Alexis.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Let's see. Well, did, did you and Tio ever play together while he was in? No, I never did there with Tio. Oh.

But what, what sort of band you played with a long time ago? The Supreme Band was the band I played with. Uh-huh. And practically most of the fellas died and I formed my own band. That's why I started getting, uh, uh, fellas out of New Orleans to play with me. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. I'd get cornet and saxophone and play one or two musicians I'd get most of the time. Uh-huh. And I used to get Kid Rainey, Kid Howard, Kid Ricardo Alexis. Uh-huh. And, uh, I even had Celestan come out and try and play with me. Uh-huh.…
No, I went up and played sax and clarinet both.

items.title: Sumner Labat Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: And then I had Kid Ricard, Ricard Alexis. He was tough and easy. And then I had, I had pretty good, what the sugar. Kai ever played with you?

ctx.x: I know he's talking about. Before your time. You know before my time? You don't remember who? Alfred. Alfred. Alfred. That's who it was. Alfred Williams. That's not Nolan. Alfred Williams. Left hand. Nolan. Left hand drummer. That's what it was.

When Ricard died, Ricard Alexis died, his wife died. I went to his way. And Grace Edwards, she used to play piano with me too. And he said, you know who's out there? Alfred Williams. I said Alfred Williams. He said, yeah, don't you know the left hand drummer? He used to play with Sam Morgan. I said, oh yeah. I said, let me see if he knew he knew me. I said, Alfred, come here. He said, you know this man? He said, no. He said, you know see me before, man. He said, no. I don't remember. I said, where you belong…
And I saw Stan had another good drummer one time. I mean Sam Morgan. Roy. Oh yeah, Roy. Little Roy Evans. Roy Evans. Do you know him too?
